text_en: Then Job answered:
text_cn: 约伯回答说：

text_en: “No doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
text_cn: 的确，只有你们是有知识的子民；那么，你们一死，智慧也与你们一同丧亡！

text_en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
text_cn: 其实，我和你们有同样的心理，我并不亚于你们！谁不知道这些事？

text_en: I am a laughingstock to my friends; I, who called upon God and he answered me, a just and blameless man, I am a laughingstock.
text_cn: 我这呼吁天主而蒙应允的人，却被他的友人所嘲笑，无辜的义人却成了笑柄。

text_en: Those at ease have contempt for misfortune, but it is ready for those whose feet are unstable.
text_cn: 幸运的人心想：遭难的人应受蔑视，失足的人应再予以打击。

text_en: The tents of robbers are at peace, and those who provoke God are secure, who bring their god in their hands.
text_cn: 但是，强盗的帐幕竟能安全，触怒天主的人，以势力为神的人却享平安。

text_en: “But ask the animals, and they will teach you; the birds of the air, and they will tell you;
text_cn: 请你询问走兽，它们也会开导你；询问天上的飞鸟，它们也会告诉你；

text_en: ask the plants of the earth, and they will teach you; and the fish of the sea will declare to you.
text_cn: 地上的爬虫也会教训你，海中的鱼族也会给你说明。

text_en: Who among all these does not know that the hand of the Lord has done this?
text_cn: 它们中有谁不知道：是天主的手创造了这一切？

text_en: In his hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of every human being.
text_cn: 因为一切活物的生魂，一切血肉之人的灵魂，都握在他手中。

text_en: Does not the ear test words as the palate tastes food?
text_cn: 耳朵不是为明辨言语，口腔不是为辨尝食物吗？

text_en: Is wisdom with the aged, and understanding in length of days?
text_cn: 白发老人是有智慧的，年纪大者是有见识的；

text_en: “With God are wisdom and strength; he has counsel and understanding.
text_cn: 但智慧和能力同在天主内，智慧与见识是天主所有。

text_en: If he tears down, no one can rebuild; if he shuts someone in, no one can open up.
text_cn: 他若拆毁，人不能再建；他若拘禁，人不得开释。

text_en: If he withholds the waters, they dry up; if he sends them out, they overwhelm the land.
text_cn: 他若制水，水便干涸；他若放水，水便冲毁大地。

text_en: With him are strength and wisdom; the deceived and the deceiver are his.
text_cn: 力量与才能，为他所有；受骗者与骗人者，都属于他。

text_en: He leads counselors away stripped, and makes fools of judges.
text_cn: 他使谋士糊涂，使判官愚蠢；

text_en: He looses the sash of kings, and binds a waistcloth on their loins.
text_cn: 他解除君王所系的玉带，将绳索捆在他们的腰间；

text_en: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
text_cn: 他使司祭赤足而行，推倒掌握大权者；

text_en: He deprives of speech those who are trusted, and takes away the discernment of the elders.
text_cn: 夺去忠贞者的辩才，剥去年老者的理智：

text_en: He pours contempt on princes, and looses the belt of the strong.
text_cn: 使贵人备受侮辱，使勇士的腰带松弛；

text_en: He uncovers the deeps out of darkness, and brings deep darkness to light.
text_cn: 使隐秘的事由暗处彰显，使黑暗进入光明；

text_en: He makes nations great, then destroys them; he enlarges nations, then leads them away.
text_cn: 使邦国兴起而又灭亡，使民族强大而又消散；

text_en: He strips understanding from the leaders of the earth, and makes them wander in a pathless waste.
text_cn: 剥去国君的理智，使他们漂泊于无路的荒野中，

text_en: They grope in the dark without light; he makes them stagger like a drunkard.
text_cn: 在无光的黑暗中摸索，踉（liàng）跄（qiàng）犹如醉汉。
